Understanding Vector Databases

A vector database stores embeddings: lists of numbers that place similar items close together. Search becomes a nearest-neighbour query instead of a keyword match.

Indexes

Approximate indexes such as HNSW trade a little recall for a large speed-up. The index is built once and updated as vectors arrive.

When not to use one

If your data fits in memory and changes rarely, a flat array and a dot product are simpler and exact. Measure before adding infrastructure.
